Risk covariance (Σ) and view uncertainty (Ω)

Σ (capital sigma) is the trailing 36-month covariance matrix of asset returns. Ω (capital omega) is a diagonal matrix of each Ridge view’s prior forecast-error variance.

Latest-month walkthrough

What happened in September 2026?

01

Releases arrived

Eight scheduled macro releases were observed by the September month-end decision date.

02

Surprises offset

Soft Industrial Production and ISM pushed Growth slightly negative. Core CPI pushed Inflation slightly positive.

03

Forecasts stayed restrained

Ridge forecast positive Equity returns and approximately flat-to-negative fixed-income returns, with strong shrinkage.

04

Allocation tilted modestly

Black–Litterman moved the benchmark to 47% Equity, 31% Treasury, and 22% IG Credit.

Guardrails

What this MVP proves—and what it does not

Point-in-time controls

Macro z-scores use prior observations only. GPR is delayed to the following decision month. ANFCI uses an assumed five-day publication lag.

Current evidence

The MVP beat the benchmark by 0.57 percentage points annualized, but delivered slightly worse Sharpe and drawdown over only 33 realized months.

Remaining limitation

ANFCI and GPR use latest revised histories. A formal locked test should reconstruct real-time vintages before making a performance claim.
